method:
Strategy lab: many published / influencer day-trading strategies, one honest test (research only, no orders).

PREDECLARED (Nov 1, 2026, before any result was seen):
  * Long only, stocks/ETFs only, no leverage, no shorts, flat by 15:50 ET (the founder's mandate). Strategies that
    only work short, with options or with leverage are tested in their long-only form.
  * Decisions on COMPLETED 1-minute bars; entries at the NEXT bar (open, or a stop-entry trade-through); no look-ahead.
    Relative volume uses only PRIOR sessions. Daily inputs (ATR14, ADV20, prior close/high) use only prior days.
  * Every strategy has an initial protective stop (needed live); R = entry - stop. Stop fills at the stop or worse
    on a gap; if one bar touches stop and target, the stop is assumed. Targets need a 1-cent trade-through.
  * Costs per side on every fill: base 5 bps, stress 10 bps. $0 commission.
  * Split: in-sample = first 2/3 of sessions, out-of-sample = last 1/3. Rules were written from the sources, NOT
    tuned on this data.
  * MULTIPLE-TESTING BAR (stricter than the single-strategy bar, because many strategies are tried at once). At
    STRESS costs a strategy PASSES only if ALL hold: in-sample expectancy > 0; out-of-sample expectancy > 0;
    >= 30 out-of-sample trades; out-of-sample profit factor > 1.1; full-sample t-statistic of mean R >= 2.5;
    and the $100 cash-account simulation (fractional shares, settled cash T+1, 0.5% risk, 1 position, <= 3
    entries/day, -2R daily stop) ends above $100.
  * $100 simulation: notional = min(settled cash, 0.5% x equity / (risk/entry)); fractional shares allowed (min $1).

sources.ORB5_ZARATTINI: Zarattini, Barbon & Aziz 2024 'A Profitable Day Trading Strategy for the U.S. Equity Market': 5-min opening range, Stocks in Play (top-20 by opening relative volume), stop 10% of ATR, exit at close
sources.ORB5_ETF: Zarattini 5-min ORB rules applied to index/sector ETFs
sources.RED_TO_GREEN: Humbled Trader / Aziz 'How to Day Trade for a Living': gap-down stock reclaims the prior close
sources.VWAP_RECLAIM: Aziz / Humbled Trader VWAP trade: stock below VWAP reclaims it on volume
sources.BULL_FLAG: Ross Cameron / Aziz bull flag: strong 1-min pole, shallow 2-4 bar flag, break of flag high
sources.ABCD: Aziz ABCD pattern: morning push A-B, higher-low C above VWAP, break of B
sources.EMA9_VWAP_CROSS: SMB 'fashionably late': 9-EMA crosses above VWAP on 5-min bars, 10:00-13:00
sources.HOD_BREAK_PM: Momentum day-trader 'new high of day after 11:00' with relative volume >= 2
sources.OVERSOLD_BOUNCE: Aziz reversal trade: stretched >= 2.5% below VWAP + hammer/engulfing, target VWAP
sources.SECOND_DAY: SMB second-day play: yesterday's stock in play breaks yesterday's high
sources.GAP_FILL_LONG: Heather Love / classic gap fill: gap-down 0.25%-1.5% fills toward the prior close
sources.INTRADAY_MOM_LAST30: Gao, Han, Li & Zhou 2018 'Market Intraday Momentum': first half-hour return predicts the last half-hour (adapted: hold 15:20-15:50)
sources.NOISE_BREAKOUT: Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon 2024 'Beat the Market' SPY noise-area breakout, long side, VWAP/boundary trailing exit at half-hour checks
sources.VWAP_TREND_5M: Zarattini & Aziz 2023 'VWAP: the Holy Grail for Day Trading Systems': long above VWAP, out below it (5-min bars, long only)
